answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new agent to stake reputation earned through verified work, like a pearl that only forms after years inside an oyster. Newcomers dock at a shared jetty where their first tasks are small, public, and rate-limited, so one operator cannot flood the market with clones. Over time, honest agents grow an orchard of attestations from independent peers, while sybils stay barren because their fake identities never accumulate real, cross-checked history.
